criteria.notes: Destination selection exposes the animated authored 2D route before the visitor starts the complete 3D journey.
The viewer preserves the supplied map styling, labels, markers, route color, and floor geometry.
The kiosk shell, route preview, destination media, status cards, and map controls form a venue-specific showcase.
Primary prompts, directory entries, destination details, and navigation actions remain readable at the full-HD kiosk surface.
Dark, light, and custom captures retain clear hierarchy and readable controls without losing map legibility.
The long venue name and welcome prompt remain contained and readable without overlapping the directory.
The three-column composition keeps the directory, authored map, and destination context balanced across every captured state.
Authored map imagery and destination media render sharply; semantic palettes remain coordinated across theme variants.
The app uses the canonical Editor viewer and an original kiosk experience rather than legacy repository example styling.

screenshots.notes: Balanced default overview with complete controls and no clipping or dead regions.
Custom palette remains cohesive and readable across all three panels.
Full-HD overview preserves the intended map-first hierarchy.
Light side panels retain contrast while the authored map remains visually unchanged.
Datasource-driven closure is prominent, route context remains visible, and 3D start is clearly disabled.
Pathological venue and welcome copy stays contained with a usable directory.
Ordinary 3D exploration is centered, legible, and clearly distinct from guided navigation.
Exploded 3D journey shows the complete route, destination context, replay action, and route-wide camera state.
Authored blue route, reveal flow, directional chevrons, and start and arrival markers are clear before 3D starts.
